findings.remediation: The runtime accepts only explicit 128, 192, and 256-bit profiles and enforces entropy, nonce, and reseed-entropy byte minima before state changes.
findings.remainingResidualRisk: Byte-length checks enforce the application contract but do not prove source min-entropy.
